the following issues: (1) the design of brand slogans of the foreign jewelry companies,which is based on the cultural background of western countries; (2) the translation of brand slogans of foreign jewelry companies in Chinese market,which is based mainly on the translation of the cultural connotation of brand slogans and the translation of brand image of foreign companies in Chinese market; (3) the design and translation of the brand slogans of domestic jewelry companies,which are mainly based on Chinese culture and Chinese consumers.

the domestic and international jewelry enterprises need to be cautious when designing and translating their brand slogans,so as to avoid the misunderstanding of their brand image and the failure in the international market.
domestic jewelry enterprises should not simply imitate foreign brand slogans, but should be more creative in their design and translation.
the domestic and international jewelry enterprises need to consider their brand image and the cultural background of consumers when they design and promote their brand slogans.
The main takeaway from our work is that
domestic jewelry enterprises should be aware of the cultural differences between Chinese and Western culture and should not ignore the cultural differences when designing brand slogans.

,when domestic jewelry enterprises design and translate brand slogan,it is necessary for them to take the cultural difference into account,especially the difference in the concept of beauty,so that they can design and translate brand slogans in a way that is more in line with the aesthetic concept of Chinese consumers,which will help them to promote the brand and enhance their brand image.

,when designing and translating brand slogan,domestic jewelry enterprises should pay attention to the following aspects:First,the brand slogan should be designed in accordance with the brand positioning,which is the core of the brand image;Second,it should be designed according to the target consumer group;Third,the slogan should be designed to be concise,concise,and easy to remember;Fourth,the brand slogan should have a strong cultural background;Fifth,it should be translated according to the cultural background of the target market.
